scope: Publish immutable versioned Production Transition policies with explicit Project applicability, receiving-group definitions, sender and receiver acknowledgement slots, handover requirements, unresolved-action rules, observation-source requirements and conclusion rules, with no installed business default.

Freeze append-only Handover Package revisions over exact same-Project Project, member, role-assignment, readiness, Work Item, released Document or Baseline, clean private File Revision, Tooling and retained Trial source identities, versions and hashes without latest-value substitution.

Append independent actor-bound acknowledgements to one exact handover package revision and required frozen slot while deriving fully acknowledged state only at query time, never rewriting the package hash and never inheriting acknowledgement facts into a successor package.

Retain a separate immutable Observation Period revision stream whose mandatory actual SOP, first-batch yield, customer complaint, production cycle and Tooling-stability providers are server-injected identity-free unavailable until separately approved external adapters exist.

Deliver the closed Project-first repository and BFF boundary, dense trilingual Project production-transition workspace, additive metadata, controlled runtime and Level 2 evidence under the frozen P7-06 plan.

Keep every Gate or G7 decision, Project lifecycle change, Work Item or Tooling mutation, ERP or customer transaction, Outbox or external projection and released output behind separate authority outside P7-06.
non_scope: Any installed default Production Transition policy, formal organization or receiving-department mapping, hard-coded G7 identity, acknowledgement quorum, signature semantics, actual-SOP provider, production-metric provider, stability threshold or business conclusion authority.

Automatic G7 pass or close, Gate input or evidence attachment, Gate policy or decision mutation, Project completion or lifecycle change, Work Item mutation, Tooling lifecycle change, production handover execution or production release.

Caller-supplied or fabricated actual SOP, yield, complaint, cycle, Tooling-stability, availability, value, score or conclusion truth; production ERPNext or customer-system access, network traffic or mutation.

Treating policy publication, readiness, evidence presence, package creation, acknowledgement or fully acknowledged state as approval, electronic signature, production acceptance, Gate authorization or acceptance by an unavailable external party.
Released Trial Summary, external event projection, production print, raw private File URLs, generic DocType CRUD, Frappe or ERPNext core patches, test deletion or threshold reduction.

rollback.before_product_resume: Before retained P7-06 rows, restore the starting controller checkpoint and migrate only a disposable Site fresh.
rollback.after_product_resume: After retained policy, package, acknowledgement or observation history, disable only the independent P7-06 routes and Project workspace and deliver a reviewed forward repair without rewriting, deleting, renumbering or inheriting retained revisions, acknowledgements, source snapshots or audit history.
